Le due serie vengono dagli stessi dati d:
The two series come from the same projection data: the Mayo collection simulated the scan at 10% of the dose. The anatomy is identical, only the noise changes.
The dose required depends on the task. A solid nodule in the lung has enormous contrast with air (about 800-900 HU): it remains visible even with a lot of noise, and for this reason screening CT is performed at low dose (about 1-1.5 mGy in current programs, even less with iterative reconstruction). The soft tissues of the mediastinum, by contrast, differ by a few tens of HU: with the streak noise of the 10% series, lymph nodes, vessels and wall are not assessable.
Noise is worst where attenuation is highest (shoulders, at the level of the apices): hence the horizontal streaks. Tube current modulation along the axis and in the plane reduces this effect.
Beware of the sharp kernel: at the edges of a solid nodule the values can exceed 200-300 HU because of edge enhancement, without any calcium being present.
Alto contrasto (nodulo nell'aria) toller: High contrast (nodule in air) tolerates very low doses; soft tissues do not.
